"It's Rab. I came because I need to talk to you.
"Hm. Only you? Sorry, but could you call your companions? I have something to tell all of you.
"Princess Jade, my partner in the Masked Tourney, has gone missing. I've searched all over town and can't find her.
"She must have been caught up in some incident. So I have a favor to ask... Will you help me find the princess?
"We need your strength to save Princess Jade. Please, won't you help?
"Hm, I'm in your debt. With the tournament champion and his friends, we're worth a hundred. We're sure to find her.
"Princess Jade vanished near Vince's orphanage. Let's go there first.
